title: Re: Selene Biotech testimonial sprint — accuracy pass & quote check
text:
Re: Selene Biotech testimonial sprint — accuracy pass & quote check

['From: Dr. Anika Rao <anika@selenebiotech.com>\\nTo: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>\\nCc: Liam O\'Neill <liam.oneill@selenebiotech.com>\\nDate: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800\\nSubject: Selene Biotech: draft testimonial for review\\n\\nHi Marissa —\\n\\nThanks again for the interview last month. We\'ve attached the draft case study your team prepared. Overall nice job; a few of our scientists asked for a quick fact-check on two metrics and one quote attribution. Quick asks below so we can sign off and share on our press channels next week: \\n\\n- Can you confirm the 45% inference cost reduction is over our baseline (on-prem GPUs) and averaged across the Q1 workload? We want the wording to be precise.\\n- The quote on page 2 attributed to \\"S. Patel\\" should be \\"S. Patel, Head of ML Ops\\" (full title).\\n- Please remove the sentence about \\"no model drift observed\\" — our compliance team prefers more cautious wording.\\n\\nWe\'ve also uploaded a clean logo file to the shared drive. Attached: selene_case_draft_v1.docx\\n\\nIf you can get a revised draft by Monday (2/8) that would be ideal.\\n\\nBest,\\nAnika\\nDr. Anika Rao\\nVP, Data Science\\nSelene Biotech\\n[Attachment: selene_case_draft_v1.docx (docx)]', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>\\nTo: Dr. Anika Rao <anika@selenebiotech.com>\\nCc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>\\nDate: Fri, 5 Feb 2027 11:08:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Selene Biotech: draft testimonial for review\\n\\nHi Anika —\\n\\nThanks for the quick read and clear notes. Appreciate the precision requests — we\'ll make those changes and send a redlined version. To confirm our plan: \\n\\n1) We will update the metric wording to read: \\"~45% reduction in per‑token inference cost versus the customer\'s on‑prem GPU baseline across Q1 production traffic (weighted average).\\" Let me know if you prefer a narrower definition (e.g., peak vs. average).\\n2) We\'ll change the attribution to \\"S. Patel, Head of ML Ops, Selene Biotech.\\"\\n3) We\'ll remove the \\"no model drift observed\\" sentence and replace it with: \\"No significant model drift detected during the three‑month evaluation window; Selene monitors drift as part of its governance practices.\\"\\n\\nI\'ve asked Jasmine to run a final pass on the numbers and Ben to prepare the visuals (before/after cost chart). Expect redlines by EOD Monday (2/8). If you can confirm the HubSpot deal ID (or provide a release contact) we\'ll include the PR contact details in the footer.\\n\\nBest,\\nMarissa\\nMarissa Cole\\nSenior Customer Marketing Manager\\nRedwood Inference\\n[Attachment: selene_redlines_v2.pdf (pdf) — will follow Monday with updated doc]', 'From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>\\nTo: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>\\nDate: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 08:43:00 -0800\\nSubject: RE: Selene Biotech: draft testimonial for review\\n\\nMarissa / Ben —\\n\\nAttached are the redlines (selene_redlines_v2.pdf) and an export of the before/after cost chart PNGs. Notes from editorial QA: \\n\\n- Confirmed the cost reduction calc: we re-ran the token distribution against Selene\'s supplied logs and the weighted average is 44.8% (rounded to 45% is fine; we add the parenthetical \\"~45%\\" in the final).\\n- Rewrote the governance sentence to the suggested softer wording.\\n- Quote attribution updated to include full title.\\n\\nTwo clarifying questions for Anika (I\'ll draft the email, Marissa): \\n1) For press timing — is the 2/12 date still a hard deadline for Selene\'s comms team?\\n2) Can we include a single architecture diagram with non-sensitive labels? We can mask any internal hostnames.\\n\\nPublishing checklist: logo (received), quote approval (pending), final visuals (Ben), PR contact (need from Anika).\\n\\nThanks — sending redlines to Anika after you sign off.\\n\\n—Jasmine\\nJasmine Liu\\nCustomer Content Lead, Redwood Inference\\n[Attachments: selene_redlines_v2.pdf (pdf), selene_costs_beforeafter.png (png)]', 'From: Dr. Anika Rao <anika@selenebiotech.com>\\nTo: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>\\nCc: Liam O\'Neill <liam.oneill@selenebiotech.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>\\nDate: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Selene Biotech: draft testimonial for review — approved edits\\n\\nHi Marissa / Jasmine —\\n\\nThanks for the fast turnaround. The redlines look good and we approve the changes below: \\n\\n- The phrasing \\"~45% reduction in per-token inference cost versus the customer\'s on-prem GPU baseline across Q1 production traffic (weighted average)\\" is acceptable.\\n- \\"S. Patel, Head of ML Ops, Selene Biotech\\" is correct.\\n- Governance language change is approved.\\n\\nOn your two questions: 2/12 is still the target for our press team, and you may include a single architecture diagram as long as IP-sensitive details are masked. Our PR contact is Liam O\'Neill (liam.oneill@selenebiotech.com).\\n\\nWe attach a brief signed approval snippet for the quote (small PNG) and confirm logo is fine. You have permission to publish once the visuals are embedded.\\n\\nBest,\\nAnika\\nDr. Anika Rao\\nVP, Data Science\\nSelene Biotech\\n[Attachments: selene_quote_approval.png (png), selene_case_draft_final.docx (docx)]']
